# Eclavin — WSET Wine Certification Mastery Platform

> Eclavin is a free WSET Level 1 and Level 2 practice quiz platform. It provides 200 structured, expert-reviewed practice questions in both Korean and English, designed to help candidates prepare thoroughly for the WSET Award in Wines examinations.

## What is Eclavin?

Eclavin (에클라뱅) is a bilingual (Korean/English) online study platform dedicated exclusively to WSET (Wine & Spirit Education Trust) exam preparation. It covers the WSET Level 1 and Level 2 syllabuses through a curated database of 200 practice questions, each with:

- A 4-option multiple choice question modeled on the actual WSET exam format
- A detailed factual explanation of why the correct answer is right and why the distractors are wrong
- An Expert Concept section summarizing the full textbook chapter
- An Exam Trap section identifying the most common mistakes real candidates make

## Who should use Eclavin?

- Students preparing for the WSET Level 1 Award in Wines (30 MCQ, 45 min, 70% pass)
- Students preparing for the WSET Level 2 Award in Wines (50 MCQ, 60 min, 55% pass / 85% Distinction)
- Wine enthusiasts seeking structured knowledge of viticulture, vinification, and major wine regions
- Hospitality and restaurant professionals building wine service expertise
- Korean-speaking wine students who need bilingual WSET resources

## Key Content Areas (WSET Level 1 — 100 Episodes)

- LO1: Grape Growing & Winemaking (Anatomy, Climate, Fermentation, Oak)
- LO2: Wine Types, Styles & Principal Grape Varieties (Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Riesling, Pinot Grigio, Pinot Noir, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Syrah)
- LO2: Regional Examples (Champagne, Bordeaux, Burgundy, Sancerre, Rioja, Chianti, Marlborough, Napa Valley)
- LO2: Sparkling (Champagne, Prosecco, Cava) & Fortified Wines (Port, Sherry, Sauternes)
- LO3: Storage, Service Temperatures, Food & Wine Pairing, Wine Faults

## Key Content Areas (WSET Level 2 — 100 Episodes)

- Module 1: Environmental Factors (Climate, Altitude, Soil, Aspect)
- Module 2: Viticulture Options (Pruning, Trellising, Yield, Irrigation)
- Module 3: Winemaking Techniques (Fermentation Chemistry, Chaptalisation, Malolactic Conversion, Lees Contact, Oak Maturation)
- Module 4: Principal Grape Varieties & Styles in detail
- Module 5-9: European GI Regions (France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Portugal)
- Module 10-11: New World Regions (USA, Australia, NZ, South Africa, Argentina, Chile)
- Module 12: Sparkling & Fortified Wine Production Methods (Traditional Method, Charmat, Flor aging, Ruby vs Tawny Port)

## Verified Accuracy

All 200 questions have been audited against:
- Official WSET Level 1 Specification (Award in Wines)
- Official WSET Level 2 Specification (Award in Wines)
- Real-world WSET candidate exam feedback (Reddit r/wine, Brainscape community)

The content follows WSET's Systematic Approach to Tasting (SAT) and uses official WSET terminology. Errors found in review are corrected on an ongoing basis.

## Mobile App

Eclavin also offers a mobile app on the Apple App Store (App ID: 6757098139) with 1,800+ questions for WSET Level 1, 2, and 3 preparation.
